items.informal_name: Floor Function Upper Bound in Floor Semirings
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] {a : R}, 0 ≤ a → ↑⌊a⌋₊ ≤ a
items.informal_description: For any non-negative element $ a $ in a floor semiring $ \alpha $, the floor of $ a $, denoted $ \lfloor a \rfloor_+ $, satisfies $ \lfloor a \rfloor_+ \leq a $ when coerced back to $ \alpha $.

items.informal_name: Floor Function Inequality Equivalence in Natural Numbers

items.informal_description: For any non-negative element $a$ in a floor semiring and natural number $n$, the inequality $\lfloor a \rfloor < n$ holds if and only if $a < n$.

items.informal_description: For any non-negative element $ a $ in a floor ring $ R $, the natural number floor of $ a $, when cast to $ R $, equals the integer floor of $ a $. Symbolically, $ (\lfloor a \rfloor_+ : R) = \lfloor a \rfloor $.

items.informal_name: Integer Floor Conversion Equals Natural Floor for Non-Negative Numbers
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorRing R]
  {a : R}, 0 ≤ a → ↑⌊a⌋₊ = ⌊a⌋
items.informal_description: For any real number $ a $ satisfying $ a \geq 0 $, the integer conversion of the natural number floor of $ a $, denoted $ \lfloor a \rfloor_+ $, is equal to the integer floor of $ a $, i.e., $ (\lfloor a \rfloor_+ : \mathbb{Z}) = \lfloor a \rfloor $.

items.informal_name: Inequality Equivalence for Natural Number Floor Function
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring α] {a : α} {n : ℕ},
  0 ≤ a → (n ≤ ⌊a⌋₊ ↔ ↑n ≤ a)
items.informal_description: For any non-negative element $a$ in a floor semiring $\alpha$ and any natural number $n$, the inequality $n \leq \lfloor a \rfloor$ holds if and only if $n$ (cast to $\alpha$) is less than or equal to $a$.

items.informal_name: Floor Function Equality Characterization in Natural Numbers
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] {a : R} {n : ℕ},
  0 ≤ a → (⌊a⌋₊ = n ↔ ↑n ≤ a ∧ a < ↑n + 1)
items.informal_description: For any element $a$ in a floor semiring with $0 \leq a$, the floor of $a$ is equal to the natural number $n$ if and only if $n \leq a < n + 1$.
